title: "A BAR SONG" LINE DANCE | Shaboozey | BEGINNER DANCE TUTORIAL | Step-by Step & Back-view!

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the line dance and its structure, then breaks down each eight-count phrase step-by-step with counts and footwork. She repeats sections slowly before practicing them at tempo and linking phrases together.

practices.what: Explains the structure of the line dance with four eight-counts and mentions a four-count break.
Breaks down the first eight-count square step moving right, front, left, and back with right-foot lead.
Repeats the first eight-count slowly with verbal counts and step directions.
Teaches the second eight-count involving side-to-side step-touches and optional claps.
Breaks down the grapevine step with three steps and a touch to the right.
Practices the second eight-count combining step-touches and grapevines.
Teaches the third eight-count starting to the left with step-touches and grapevines.
Repeats the third eight-count while introducing a scuff variation on the final step.
Demonstrates how to use the scuff footwork to turn to the second wall.
Puts the first three eight-counts together slowly from the top.
Breaks down the final fourth eight-count incorporating heel digs and hip rocks.
Reviews all four eight-counts together slowly from the beginning.

adaptations.adjustment: Step and touch or move around freely if preferred
Clap on counts two and four when the foot touches
Clapping is optional on the touch
Step out to the right instead of jumping if you prefer not to jump

beliefs.belief: If you are up and moving, you are dancing correctly.
The teacher's role is to break down steps into simple, manageable parts.

feelings.response: The teacher tells the learner they are doing an amazing job and that it is okay to rewind and practice at a slower tempo.

moments.says: The teacher reminds the learner that if they are up and moving, they are doing it right.
The teacher invites the learner to get up and start the line dance.
The teacher encourages the learner to just step-touch and move around if they are unsure.
The teacher offers the option to clap on specific counts to help with the rhythm.
The teacher reminds the learner that the video is recorded and they can pause and review the steps as needed.
The teacher offers an easier version of a jump by stepping out instead.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and encouraged, knowing that they can learn at their own pace.

struggles.theme: Had to rewind a lot to learn

clicked.theme: Back view makes it much easier to follow without mirroring
Demonstrating slow first, breaking down and repeating helps

requests.theme: Ask for separate channels for each dance style
Requests tutorial for Poison from Hazbin Hotel

meant.theme: Learning this line dance is fun and accessible

method.limits: Music is excluded from the tutorial video as stated by the instructor.
